question: Approve the ideation of codex-reader-resolved-mark-adr to enter implementation? FO recommends approve; approving accepts that recommendation and its one decision as recommended: besides ADR 0039 (exact text in the task's Design), the PR adds the one pointer comment adr_lint requires in the protected code, '# see docs/adr/0039-a-resolved-thread-does-not-clear-a-codex-finding-on-the-same-head.md' above the held-findings line in kc-dev-flow-2/extensions/codex/codex_review.py.

artifacts.summary: ADR 0039 records D1 of codex-reader-same-head-unresolved: a person's resolved mark on a GitHub thread does not clear a Codex finding on an unchanged head. It quotes the Captain's 「全准」 gate resolution verbatim with its state commit and resolution id, and protects codex_review.py state(). The ADR alone fails adr_lint ('codex_review.py has no pointer'); the one comment makes it exit 0. Worse: one comment line in product code; without it the ADR cannot land without changing the linter or dropping Protects.
